records.context: AnnData stores NaN values, but ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` and most of scvi-tools either propagate NaN across the whole matrix or raise. Every policy therefore reports the missing values it found. Filling with zero is not the default because in spaCR a NaN usually carries meaning: a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it, a Zernike column is NaN when mahotas was not installed, and a correlation column is NaN when one channel was flat. Zero-filling the first turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size" and puts it into the same distribution as a measured one.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#7
records.source: AnnData stores NaN values, but ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` and most of scvi-tools either propagate NaN across the whole matrix or raise. Every policy therefore reports the missing values it found. Filling with zero is not the default because in spaCR a NaN usually carries meaning: a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it, a Zernike column is NaN when mahotas was not installed, and a correlation column is NaN when one channel was flat. Zero-filling the first turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size" and puts it into the same distribution as a measured one.
records.translation: AnnData almacena valores NaN, pero ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` y la mayor parte de scvi-tools propagan NaN por toda la matriz o lanzan una excepción. Por ello, cada política informa de los valores ausentes que encuentra. Rellenar con cero no es la opción predeterminada, porque en spaCR un NaN suele tener significado: una columna ``pathogen_*`` es NaN para una célula sin patógeno, una columna de Zernike es NaN cuando mahotas no estaba instalado y una columna de correlación es NaN cuando un canal era constante. Rellenar la primera con cero convierte "no pathogen" («sin patógeno») en «un patógeno de tamaño cero» y lo incorpora a la misma distribución que un patógeno medido.

records.context: 1. **Flatten.** Denoise with a 1 px Gaussian, then subtract a heavily smoothed copy (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) to remove illumination gradients. The sigma is deliberately far larger than any plausible object so that flattening removes vignetting without removing the objects — the opposite trade-off (a tight rolling ball) shrinks what it is trying to measure. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the structural amplitude of the flattened plane (p99 - p30) against the *pixel-level* noise scale, measured as ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` on the raw plane. A pure-noise plane scores below 1; a plane with real objects scores in the tens. Below ``min_snr`` the field is discarded rather than thresholded, because Otsu returns a threshold even for pure noise, and the resulting size looks valid. 3. **Threshold and label.** Otsu, fill holes, label, drop components that touch the image border (truncated, so their size is too small) and components that are absurd (equivalent diameter below ``min_object_diameter``, or area above ``max_object_fraction`` of the field). Sizes are equivalent diameters, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Drop specks, then take the median.** A textured or punctate stain (a mitochondrial cell stain, a parasite marker) thresholds into a few whole objects plus hundreds of 4-10 px specks, and a plain median counts every speck as an object: on spaCR's own test laboratory microplate that put the cell at 8 px and the pathogen at 11 px against 175 px and 32 px in the curated masks, while the nucleus, whose stain is solid, came out right at 91 px. So the typical object is first located by the stained area it carries (the area-weighted median, which specks cannot move because they hold almost no area), everything narrower than :data:`SPECK_FRACTION` of it is dropped, and the characteristic size is the median of what remains. Small components that together hold :data:`SPECK_MAX_AREA_SHARE` of the stained area or more are a second population, not specks, and stay. 5. **Cross-check by distance transform.** Step 3 has one dominant failure mode: a confluent monolayer fuses into a single component, that component touches the border and is dropped, and the estimate is then computed from whatever debris survived — biased **low**, and silently. So the Euclidean distance transform of the (unfilled) foreground is computed as well, its local maxima are taken as one seed per object (two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass), and a watershed on ``-EDT`` splits the fused foreground back into objects whose equivalent diameters are measured the same way.
records.label: spacr.diameter#6

records.translation: 1. **Corregir el fondo.** Reducir el ruido con una gaussiana de 1 px y restar después una copia fuertemente suavizada (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) para eliminar gradientes de iluminación. Sigma es deliberadamente mucho mayor que cualquier objeto plausible, de modo que la corrección elimina el viñeteado sin eliminar los objetos; la elección opuesta (una bola rodante pequeña) reduce aquello que intenta medir. 2. **Rechazar el ruido.** Comparar la amplitud estructural del plano corregido (p99 - p30) con la escala del ruido *a nivel de píxel*, medida como ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` en el plano original. Un plano de ruido puro obtiene menos de 1; un plano con objetos reales obtiene valores de decenas. Por debajo de ``min_snr`` se descarta el campo en lugar de umbralizarlo, porque Otsu devuelve un umbral incluso para ruido puro y el tamaño resultante parece válido. 3. **Umbralizar y etiquetar.** Aplicar Otsu, rellenar huecos, etiquetar y descartar componentes que toquen el borde de la imagen (están truncados y su tamaño es demasiado pequeño) o sean inverosímiles (diámetro equivalente inferior a ``min_object_diameter`` o área superior a ``max_object_fraction`` del campo). Los tamaños son diámetros equivalentes, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Descartar motas y tomar la mediana.** Una tinción texturada o puntiforme (una tinción mitocondrial de células o un marcador de parásitos) se umbraliza en unos pocos objetos completos y cientos de motas de 4-10 px; una mediana simple cuenta cada mota como objeto. En la placa de prueba de spaCR esto dio 8 px para la célula y 11 px para el patógeno, frente a 175 px y 32 px en las máscaras revisadas, mientras que el núcleo, cuya tinción es uniforme, dio correctamente 91 px. Por ello, primero se localiza el objeto típico por su área teñida (la mediana ponderada por área, que las motas no desplazan porque contienen muy poca área), se descarta todo lo más estrecho que :data:`SPECK_FRACTION` de ese tamaño y el tamaño característico es la mediana de lo restante. Los componentes pequeños que juntos representan :data:`SPECK_MAX_AREA_SHARE` o más del área teñida constituyen una segunda población, no motas, y se conservan. 5. **Contrastar con la transformada de distancia.** El paso 3 tiene un fallo predominante: una monocapa confluente se fusiona en un único componente, que toca el borde y se descarta; la estimación se calcula entonces con los restos que hayan sobrevivido, con un sesgo **a la baja** y sin aviso. Por ello también se calcula la transformada de distancia euclídea del primer plano sin rellenar y se toma un máximo local como semilla por objeto (dos pasadas: una inicial aproximada fija el radio de supresión de la refinada). Una segmentación watershed sobre ``-EDT`` vuelve a dividir el primer plano fusionado en objetos, cuyos diámetros equivalentes se miden del mismo modo.

records.context: **Assumption tests have their own power.** With n = 3, Levene's test has almost no power, so "p = 0.7" means the variances could not be compared, not that they are equal. Using that result to select Student's t can report a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records both checks as uninformative, treats the data as not normal, and selects a rank test (Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank when paired, or Kruskal-Wallis for more than two groups). This loses some power when the assumptions hold and avoids false positives when they do not.
records.label: spacr.figures.stats#4
records.source: **Assumption tests have their own power.** With n = 3, Levene's test has almost no power, so "p = 0.7" means the variances could not be compared, not that they are equal. Using that result to select Student's t can report a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records both checks as uninformative, treats the data as not normal, and selects a rank test (Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank when paired, or Kruskal-Wallis for more than two groups). This loses some power when the assumptions hold and avoids false positives when they do not.
records.translation: **Las pruebas de supuestos tienen su propia potencia.** Con n = 3, la prueba de Levene apenas tiene potencia, por lo que «p = 0.7» significa que no pudieron compararse las varianzas, no que sean iguales. Utilizar ese resultado para elegir la t de Student puede indicar una diferencia inexistente. Por debajo de :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS`, este módulo registra ambas comprobaciones como no informativas, trata los datos como no normales y elige una prueba de rangos (Mann-Whitney U, rangos con signo de Wilcoxon para datos pareados o Kruskal-Wallis para más de dos grupos). Esto pierde algo de potencia cuando se cumplen los supuestos y evita falsos positivos cuando no se cumplen.

records.context: The error is held out and the selection is not. Whether a penalty predicts well is a question about unseen microplate sample positions; whether it selects anything is a question about the fit the caller will get, which is fitted on every well. Reading selection off the folds can choose a penalty at which most folds keep a gene while the full fit keeps none (on the tsg101 screening experiment it chose 0.000183 and the full fit was empty).
records.label: spacr.group_lasso.choose_lambda.score#1
records.source: The error is held out and the selection is not. Whether a penalty predicts well is a question about unseen wells; whether it selects anything is a question about the fit the caller will get, which is fitted on every well. Reading selection off the folds can choose a penalty at which most folds keep a gene while the full fit keeps none (on the tsg101 screen it chose 0.000183 and the full fit was empty).
records.translation: El error se evalúa con datos reservados; la selección, no. Que una penalización prediga con precisión depende de pocillos no vistos; que seleccione algo depende del ajuste que recibirá quien llama, realizado con todos los pocillos. Evaluar la selección a partir de las particiones puede elegir una penalización con la que la mayoría de las particiones conserva un gen pero el ajuste completo no conserva ninguno (en el cribado tsg101 se eligió 0.000183 y el ajuste completo quedó vacío).

records.context: Ignoring spacing produces no visible error: an overlay drawn a slice out of register still looks like a plausible image, and any number measured from it is wrong without a warning. For this reason a zero scale raises, and a stack throws :exc:`LayerError` when µm layers and px layers are mixed instead of drawing them on top of each other.
records.label: spacr.layers#10

For this reason a zero scale raises, and a stack raises :exc:`LayerError` when µm layers and px layers are mixed instead of drawing them on top of each other.
records.translation: Ignorar el espaciado no produce un error visible: una superposición desplazada un corte sigue pareciendo una imagen plausible y cualquier medición obtenida de ella es incorrecta sin que se emita aviso. Por eso una escala cero lanza una excepción, y una pila lanza :exc:`LayerError` al mezclar capas en µm con capas en px, en lugar de dibujarlas unas sobre otras.

The GPU and the CPU renderers use the same numbers.

records.translation: Un punto de superficie de color base ``c`` y normal unitaria ``n`` se dibuja como ``c * (ambient + diffuse * max(n.l, 0)) + specular * max(n.h, 0) ** shininess * mix(white, c, tint)``, donde ``l`` apunta hacia la luz y ``h`` a medio camino entre la luz y el observador. Los renderizadores de GPU y CPU usan los mismos valores.

records.translation: Las posiciones son índices continuos del array del volumen dibujado (el vóxel ``i`` está centrado en el índice ``i``). La muestra ``k`` del rayo que atraviesa la fila de salida ``r`` y la columna ``c`` se encuentra en ``origin + c * across + r * down + k * depth``; la muestra 0 es la más cercana al observador.

records.context: ``percent`` is the share of full resolution along each axis: at 50 % every second voxel along X, Y and Z (an eighth of the voxels) is drawn, into a picture of half the display's width and height. While the view is dragged the frame is drawn coarser still and then again at the slider's scale once it stops: the CPU draws from at most :data:`RENDER_DRAG_VOXELS` voxels into pixels of at least 4 display pixels; the GPU keeps its voxels (so nothing is uploaded again) and draws pixels of at least 2.
records.label: spacr.layers.render_scale#1
records.source: ``percent`` is the share of full resolution along each axis: at 50 % every second voxel along X, Y and Z (an eighth of the voxels) is drawn, into a picture of half the display's width and height. While the view is dragged the frame is drawn coarser still and then again at the slider's scale once it stops: the CPU draws from at most :data:`RENDER_DRAG_VOXELS` voxels into pixels of at least 4 display pixels; the GPU keeps its voxels (so nothing is uploaded again) and draws pixels of at least 2.
records.translation: ``percent`` es la fracción de la resolución completa en cada eje: al 50 % se dibuja un vóxel de cada dos en X, Y y Z (un octavo de los vóxeles), en una imagen con la mitad de la anchura y la altura de la pantalla. Mientras se arrastra la vista, el fotograma se dibuja con una resolución aún menor; al detenerse se vuelve a dibujar a la escala del control deslizante. La CPU usa como máximo :data:`RENDER_DRAG_VOXELS` vóxeles y píxeles de al menos 4 píxeles de pantalla; la GPU conserva sus vóxeles (sin volver a cargarlos) y dibuja píxeles de al menos 2.

records.context: Image layers are added together, each through its colormap, between its contrast limits, times its opacity; each is drawn by the :data:`VOLUME_RENDERINGS` mode in ``layer.metadata["rendering"]`` (``mip`` when absent). Labels layers are then laid over them in stack order, each object in its :func:`label_color`, by the :data:`LABEL_RENDERINGS` mode (``surface`` when absent) and the layer's opacity. A surface is lit by the :data:`SURFACE_FINISHES` entry in ``layer.metadata["finish"]`` (``matte`` when absent), with normals from the mask itself (:func:`surface_normals`). Hidden layers draw nothing. Every layer must have the volume's shape; image layers draw their first image data channel. :class:`GLVolumeRenderer` draws the same picture on the GPU.
records.label: spacr.layers.render_volume#1
records.source: Image layers are added together, each through its colormap, between its contrast limits, times its opacity; each is drawn by the :data:`VOLUME_RENDERINGS` mode in ``layer.metadata["rendering"]`` (``mip`` when absent). Labels layers are then laid over them in stack order, each object in its :func:`label_color`, by the :data:`LABEL_RENDERINGS` mode (``surface`` when absent) and the layer's opacity. A surface is lit by the :data:`SURFACE_FINISHES` entry in ``layer.metadata["finish"]`` (``matte`` when absent), with normals from the mask itself (:func:`surface_normals`). Hidden layers draw nothing. Every layer must have the volume's shape; image layers draw their first channel. :class:`GLVolumeRenderer` draws the same picture on the GPU.
records.translation: Las capas de imagen se suman, cada una mediante su mapa de colores, entre sus límites de contraste y multiplicada por su opacidad; cada capa se dibuja con el modo de :data:`VOLUME_RENDERINGS` indicado en ``layer.metadata["rendering"]`` (``mip`` si falta). Después se superponen las capas de etiquetas en el orden de la pila, cada objeto con su :func:`label_color`, usando el modo de :data:`LABEL_RENDERINGS` (``surface`` si falta) y la opacidad de la capa. Una superficie se ilumina con la entrada de :data:`SURFACE_FINISHES` indicada en ``layer.metadata["finish"]`` (``matte`` si falta), con normales obtenidas de la propia máscara (:func:`surface_normals`). Las capas ocultas no dibujan nada. Todas las capas deben tener la forma del volumen; las capas de imagen dibujan su primer canal. :class:`GLVolumeRenderer` dibuja la misma imagen en la GPU.

records.context: The statsmodels default optimiser runs first. If it raises or does not converge, REML fits under ``lbfgs``, ``powell`` and ``cg`` follow. Only if every optimiser produces an error on the full model is the guide variance component dropped and a gene-only random intercept fitted; the record and the log say so, because guides that disagree then no longer widen the gene interval.
records.label: spacr.ml.fit_mixed_model#10
records.source: The statsmodels default optimiser runs first. If it raises or does not converge, REML fits under ``lbfgs``, ``powell`` and ``cg`` follow. Only if every optimiser raises on the full model is the guide variance component dropped and a gene-only random intercept fitted; the record and the log say so, because guides that disagree then no longer widen the gene interval.
records.translation: Primero se ejecuta el optimizador predeterminado de statsmodels. Si lanza una excepción o no converge, se realizan ajustes REML con ``lbfgs``, ``powell`` y ``cg``. Solo si todos los optimizadores lanzan una excepción con el modelo completo se elimina el componente de varianza de las guías y se ajusta un intercepto aleatorio únicamente por gen; tanto el registro del ajuste como el registro de ejecución lo indican, porque las guías que discrepan ya no amplían entonces el intervalo del gen.

records.context: pi0(lambda) = #{p > lambda} / (m * (1 - lambda)) is computed over a grid of lambda values (default 0.05 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05); the estimate is the minimum over the upper half of the grid (lambda at or above the grid median), clipped to (0, 1]. With fewer than 20 finite P values, an empty grid, or a non-positive estimate, the function returns 1.0, which makes the q-values equal to Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted P values.
records.label: spacr.multiple_testing.estimate_pi0#1
records.source: pi0(lambda) = #{p > lambda} / (m * (1 - lambda)) is computed over a grid of lambda values (default 0.05 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05); the estimate is the minimum over the upper half of the grid (lambda at or above the grid median), clipped to (0, 1]. With fewer than 20 finite P values, an empty grid, or a non-positive estimate, the function returns 1.0, which makes the q-values equal to Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted P values.
records.translation: pi0(lambda) = #{p > lambda} / (m * (1 - lambda)) se calcula sobre una cuadrícula de valores de lambda (por defecto, de 0.05 a 0.95 en pasos de 0.05); la estimación es el mínimo en la mitad superior de la cuadrícula (lambda igual o superior a su mediana), limitado a (0, 1]. Con menos de 20 valores P finitos, una cuadrícula vacía o una estimación no positiva, la función devuelve 1.0, lo que hace que los valores q sean iguales a los valores P ajustados por Benjamini-Hochberg.

records.context: **A point that fails is reported as failed.**  A fit that raises lands as ``status="failed"`` with the exception text in ``error``; a fit that executes but does not meet its convergence criterion lands as ``status="not_converged"``.  Both carry ``NaN`` metrics.  A sweep that filled in 0.5 for failed points would plot them as a design performing at chance, which would confuse "this design cannot find its hits" with "this fit failed".
records.label: spacr.power_model.scan_parameters#2
records.source: **A point that fails is reported as failed.**  A fit that raises lands as ``status="failed"`` with the exception text in ``error``; a fit that runs but does not meet its convergence criterion lands as ``status="not_converged"``.  Both carry ``NaN`` metrics.  A sweep that filled in 0.5 for failed points would plot them as a design performing at chance, which would confuse "this design cannot find its hits" with "this fit failed".
records.translation: **Un punto que falla se informa como fallido.** Un ajuste que lanza una excepción queda como ``status="failed"``, con el texto de la excepción en ``error``; uno que se ejecuta pero no cumple su criterio de convergencia queda como ``status="not_converged"``. Ambos llevan métricas ``NaN``. Un barrido que rellenase los puntos fallidos con 0.5 los representaría como un diseño cuyo rendimiento equivale al azar, confundiendo «este diseño no puede detectar sus resultados positivos» con "this fit failed" («este ajuste falló»).

records.context: Self-supervised denoising comes before the chain. With ``n2v_denoise`` on, a Noise2Void (N2V2) model per segmentation image data channel is trained by CAREamics, in its own environment, on a sample of the processing session's own raw microscope fields of view -- no clean images are needed -- or read from ``n2v_model``. Each microscope field of view's selected image data channels are denoised after illumination correction and before the PSF and the chain, while the noise is still independent from pixel to pixel, which is what Noise2Void assumes. The checkpoints' hashes and the training record join the same provenance record.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#4
records.source: Self-supervised denoising comes before the chain. With ``n2v_denoise`` on, a Noise2Void (N2V2) model per segmentation channel is trained by CAREamics, in its own environment, on a sample of the run's own raw fields -- no clean images are needed -- or read from ``n2v_model``. Each field's selected channels are denoised after illumination correction and before the PSF and the chain, while the noise is still independent from pixel to pixel, which is what Noise2Void assumes. The checkpoints' hashes and the training record join the same provenance record.
records.translation: La eliminación de ruido autosupervisada precede a la cadena. Con ``n2v_denoise`` activado, CAREamics entrena en su propio entorno un modelo Noise2Void (N2V2) por canal de segmentación usando una muestra de los campos originales de la ejecución —no se necesitan imágenes limpias—, o lo carga desde ``n2v_model``. Los canales seleccionados de cada campo se procesan después de la corrección de iluminación y antes de la PSF y de la cadena, cuando el ruido aún es independiente entre píxeles, como supone Noise2Void. Los hashes de los puntos de control y el registro del entrenamiento se incorporan al mismo registro de procedencia.
